subject: dsa
title: Valid Parentheses
summary: Push every opener onto a stack. On a closer, the top must be the matching opener — pop it. Valid means every closer matched and the stack ends empty.
problem: Return true if every opening bracket is closed by the correct type, in the right order.

steps.caption: Every opener must be closed by the right kind, in the right order. A stack tracks the open ones (highlighted).
'(' opens — push it onto the stack.
'[' opens — push it too. On the stack: ( and [.
']' closes. The top is '[' — a match, so pop it.
')' closes. The top is now '(' — a match, so pop it. The stack is empty.
Every bracket matched and the stack emptied — the string is valid. A wrong type or a leftover opener would make it false.
